executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Please create specific tests for the tagging and signing functionality. Test these specific endpoints: POST /api/editor/session/:sessionId/place-text-tag, PUT /api/editor/session/:sessionId/text-tag/:tagId, GET /api/editor/session/:sessionId/text-tags, POST /api/document/sign, GET /api/digital-signatures/job/:jobId, POST /api/digital-signatures/verify, POST /api/text/process, GET /api/text/tags, POST /api/text/tags. Focus on testing text tag placement, coordinate validation, font management, digital signature creation, certificate verification, and the complete tagging-to-signing workflow.
